noManagePermission: Only a government (DNA) Admin or Root user can manage cooperative approaches.
invalidDateRange: The cooperative approach start date must be before its end date.
invalidTransition: Cooperative approach {} cannot move from {} to {}.
activationRequiresSubmittedIr: Cooperative approach {} cannot be activated until its initial report has been submitted (Dec 2/CMA.3 Annex para 18).
entityRequiresActiveCa: Authorized entities can only be added to an Active cooperative approach ({} is not Active).
countryOfIncorporationNotParticipating: Country of incorporation {} is not a participating party of cooperative approach {}.
authorizationDateInFuture: The authorization date cannot be in the future.
participatingPartyInUse: Participating party {} cannot be removed from cooperative approach {} — an active authorized entity is incorporated there.
transitionFromCompleted: Cooperative approach {} is Completed — its lifecycle has ended and its status cannot change. To start a new bilateral arrangement, create a fresh cooperative approach.
transitionFromRevoked: Cooperative approach {} was Revoked under Draft -/CMA.5 paras 20-21. Revoked is terminal; no further status changes are permitted.
transitionRevertToDraft: Cooperative approach {} cannot revert from {} to Draft. Once a CA leaves Draft, its working version is fixed.
